stats.source: GOB 95 applies learned-rank 0.3 bonuses to Viral Damage and Viral Resistance.
stats.runtime: AbilityPassives publishes both totals. AbilityStats.ScaleTypedAbilityDamage and TypedResistanceBonuses.Player consume them. The retail resistance coefficient remains unresolved.
stats.test: AbilityScaledBuffTests.TransmitVirusAndOverclockApplyTheirOwnTypedDamageAndResistance verifies +15/+15 level-50 totals, increased outgoing viral damage, unchanged ballistic damage and reduced incoming viral damage.

area.source: GOB 97 stores selector 4 and 3 m radius. Native 621e26d8 reads the caster-area description.
area.runtime: UiLagArea.Land snapshots the caster centre, checks authority, and applies separate visible enemy contests.
area.test: UiLagAreaTests.SelectedViewNeverMovesCentreAndNearPlayersLandOnce, OrdinaryRecipientAuthorityStaysInForce and the ui-lag-area hit/deflect wire scenarios exercise radius edges, caster centre, selected-far exclusion and legal recipients.

stats.source: GOB 97 stores four 27-second combat penalties. The morpheuzzz_001 09:45:41 capture reports -10 thrown accuracy, -17 viral defense, -12 thrown defense and -14 viral accuracy.
stats.runtime: TempMods preserves the captured values, and AbilityStats.ViralAccuracy, ThrownAccuracy and SpecialDefense read the active modifiers.
stats.test: UiLagAreaTests.CapturedRecipientValuesStayDistinctAndTwentySevenSeconds and SelectedViewNeverMovesCentreAndNearPlayersLandOnce assert all four live consumers. The retail formula reconciling the captured values with the GOB fixed -10 remains unverified.

stats.source: GOB 327 applies Viral Damage for 20 seconds. The retained activation capture has +43, distinct from the character-level function.
stats.runtime: AbilityBuffs applies and expires the captured modifier. AbilityStats.ScaleTypedAbilityDamage reads it for viral health damage.
stats.test: AbilityScaledBuffTests.TransmitVirusAndOverclockApplyTheirOwnTypedDamageAndResistance verifies +43, exact viral damage change, unaffected ballistic type, and expiry.

behavior-tests.source: GOB 354 applies -58 current and maximum IS and -50% regeneration. Max IS and regeneration expire after 30 seconds.
behavior-tests.runtime: AbilityHostile.LandedOnPlayer handles the instant modifier. TimedEffects and AbilityBuffs.RefreshVitals apply and restore max IS. AbilityHandler consumes the regeneration modifier.
behavior-tests.test: AbilityHostileTests.DestroyResolveTakesCurrentInnerStrengthAtOnce and DestroyDebuffsScaleNaturalRegenUntilExpiry test resource mutation and timed cleanup. ability-status and stock PR315/327 confirm presentation. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/327#issuecomment-7006496068

stats.source: GOB 355 stores a 30-second Viral Defense modifier. The retained crashover2k_008 capture entry 40322 supplies -60.
stats.runtime: TempMods preserves the captured modifier. AbilityStats.SpecialDefense and the free-cast viral contest consume stat 183.
stats.test: AbilityHostileTests.VectorPreservesTheCapturedPowerlessAndViralDefenseValues checks the active typed defender score, expiry of both effects, and baseline restoration. The difference from the GOB fixed -35 remains unresolved.

targeting.source: GOB 98 grants 1077. GOB 1077 is self-only and stores Viral Resistance +20, Concentration +5, Viral Accuracy +3 while active.
targeting.runtime: AbilityPassives resolves the loaded discipline grant. AbilitySupport.Targets selects the caster. AbilityStats, TypedAbilityResistance, and AbilityCastInterrupts consume the active modifiers.
targeting.test: AbilityScaledBuffTests.VirologistGrantsTheSelfUpgradeAndFeedsItsTypedConsumers exercises grant installation, non-self view ignored, all three values, typed damage resistance, Concentration cast-through, and removal/unload.
